name: app.me3/me3
title: ME3
description: Find people and small businesses on ME3, see what they offer and when they're free, and book.

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Find people and small businesses on ME3 by what they do and where, for example a hairdresser in Galway. Returns each match with their trade, town, starting price, next free time, what they offer and their site. Give from and to dates to return only people free in that window.

query.description: What the person is looking for, such as a trade, service or product.

place.description: Town, region or country to look in.

country.description: Two-letter country code, such as IE.

type.description: Only people with services, or only with products.

from.description: First day they must be free (YYYY-MM-DD).

to.description: Last day of the window, at most 7 days after from.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Read one listed ME3 person's public profile: who they are, where they are, and every service and product with its price and duration. Use the offering ids it returns with check_availability and start_booking.

site.description: The person's ME3 handle or site address, as returned in `site` or `url` by search_people.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: List the free start times for one of a person's bookable services, day by day, in their own timezone. Covers up to 7 days; without dates it covers the next 7 days, and without an offering it uses their lowest-priced service.

site.description: The person's ME3 handle or site address, as returned in `site` or `url` by search_people.

offering_id.description: A service id from get_profile or search_people, such as service:cut.

from.description: First day to check (YYYY-MM-DD). Today by default.

to.description: Last day to check, at most 7 days after from.

tools.name: start_booking
tools.description: Get the link where the person books a service or buys a product on the seller's own site. Give date and time from check_availability and the booking form opens with that slot chosen. If the seller takes enquiries for this offer instead (kind enquiry), the link opens their enquiry form. Nothing is booked, held, charged or sent by this tool: give the person the link to finish there.

site.description: The person's ME3 handle or site address, as returned in `site` or `url` by search_people.

offering_id.description: The service or product id from get_profile or search_people.

date.description: The day the person chose, from check_availability (YYYY-MM-DD).

time.description: The start time the person chose, from check_availability (HH:MM, the seller's local time).

starts_at.description: Older form of date and time; prefer date and time.
